systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Regional Planning
systems.tiers: Supplied by the ministry to all communes; the Court of Accounts found it unused in the nine audited communes (Bouira, Tizi Ouzou, M'Sila, Bordj Bou Arreridj and Boumerdes wilayas, audit period 2019-2022)

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Regional Planning
systems.tiers: Described by the ministry's secretary-general as tracking the lighting network in all communes and wilayas

systems.country_label: نظام اليقظة والتنبيه: الرقم الأخضر 3007 وتطبيقة نظيف
systems.tiers: Citizens report waste offences; the agency forwards the reports to the communes concerned. Ghardaia commune says it retrieved them from the daira's account

systems.system: الأرضية الرقمية الوطنية (national digital platform), link for reporting school heating
systems.tiers: A wali's reply says a link on it is used for daily reporting and follow-up of primary-school heating; who enters the reports is not stated

systems.system: السجل الوطني الإلكتروني للحالة المدنية (national electronic civil-status register)
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior and Local Authorities
systems.tiers: Named only as the register the health ministry's planned digital death-certificate platform is to be linked to; use at commune offices not stated

systems.system: منصة رقمية للشهادة الطبية للوفاة (digital medical death-certificate platform)
systems.tiers: Provided for by executive decree 22-178 of 28 April 2022; not yet put into operation at the time of the report

note: Court of Accounts annual report 2024 (passages): audits of communes' lighting, waste, schools, markets, beaches and pounds. It names applications supplied to communes but states nothing about the connection of commune offices, so no fact.
